products.name: Parachinari Lobya Sada
products.description: A warm, comforting bowl of traditional Parachinari red kidney beans (Lobya Sada) cooked in a mildly spiced, flavorful onion-tomato gravy. Served in a rustic bowl with fresh coriander, ginger juliennes and deshi ghee.

products.name: Parachinari Lobya Karahi
products.description: Traditional Pakistani Parachinari red kidney bean karahi bubbling in a sizzling cast-iron wok with thick, spicy red gravy.

products.name: Parachinari Lobya Seekh Karahi
products.description: A sizzling fusion dish of traditional red kidney beans (Parachinari Lobya) cooked with tender, charred pieces of minced-meat seekh kababs in a rich, spicy karahi masala gravy.

products.name: Cultural Tikka Seekh
products.description: A platter of traditional Pashtun-style cultural seekh kababs, grilled over open charcoal embers with authentic smoky char marks.

products.name: Cultural Tikka Seekh Karahi
products.description: Grilled cultural tikka seekh kababs simmered in a luscious, robust tomato-ginger-garlic karahi reduction.

products.name: Parachinari Chawal (Kurrmywaly Wrejy)
products.description: A platter of authentic Parachinari-style rice (Kurrmywaly Wrejy) featuring fragrant, seasoned rice cooked with chickpeas or mixed grains, served with a succulent golden-roasted chicken piece on top. Accompanied by shurba and mint raita.

products.name: Kurrmy Waily Wrejy (Gade Wady)
products.description: Authentic traditional Parachinari Kurrmy Waily mixed-grain seasoned rice (Gade Wady) served in a round ceramic dinner plate, emitting delicate steam, garnished with golden fried onions.
